rationale: Builds an LLM-driven dual-system voice agent that learns when to delegate to a slow-thinking tool-using agent.
Presents a multi-agent LLM system with role-specific agents and tool-driven generation; applied to molecular optimization but the contribution is the agent architecture.
Introduces an agent benchmark evaluating frontier LLM agents' autonomous evidence retrieval/reasoning under tool-call budgets.
Agentic framework in which agents distill and reuse skills from execution trajectories for visual reasoning tasks.
Benchmark suite explicitly for inference performance of agentic LLMs with multi-turn tool-calling workloads.
Benchmark for the full define/execute/update planning lifecycle of personalized tool-calling LLM agents.
Studies and mitigates tool-schema bias in LLM agents' tool use across eleven models.
Runtime defense for LLM-based web agents against deceptive interfaces; an agent-safety contribution.
Taxonomy and harness-centric analysis of LLM-driven Data Agents across the data-science lifecycle.
Reliability-engineering framework spans general AI systems (CNNs, autonomous-vehicle disengagement); not centered on LLM-driven agents specifically.
Multi-agent, tool-grounded LLM framework for chemistry problem solving; agent-architecture contribution applied to a domain.
Benchmark for safety failures arising from self-evolving LLM agents modifying their own harness, memory, and tools.
Mainly a math/CS proof-discovery benchmark for LLMs; agent-workflow comparison is a secondary analysis, not the paper's main contribution.
Communication-theory tutorial for embodied multi-agent systems generally; no LLM-driven agent focus.
Multi-robot VLN coordination explicitly coupling an LLM-based subtask scheduler with shared memory.
Refreshable benchmark explicitly for anomaly detection in LLM-based multi-agent system traces.
Agentic framework auditing third-party Agent Skills for malicious behavior; an agent-safety/supply-chain contribution.
Decentralized MARL/queueing framework for hospital patient flow; no LLM involved.
Benchmark of multimodal GUI agents operating professional scientific software.
LLM-driven recommendation-agent framework with autonomous perception and dynamic memory.
Defense against topology-inference attacks on LLM-based multi-agent systems.
Training-free context-compression method specifically for LLM agents' interaction histories.
Main contribution is a synthetic VQA data-generation framework for spatial-reasoning MLLMs; multi-agent coding is only the implementation mechanism, not the research focus.
Benchmark evaluating LLM agents on enterprise strategic reasoning and long-horizon decision-making.
Benchmark of frontier agents operating professional engineering software end to end.
Figure-centric MLLM reasoning/QA benchmark for scientific interpretation; does not test agentic tool use or planning.
Studies whether an autonomous LLM-based coding agent can optimize mature scientific software unsupervised.
Framework and benchmark (CAPS-Eval) for autonomous LLM-driven social agents' interaction behavior.
Agents that search for and modify their own instructions/tools using records of prior self-improvement episodes.
Dataset/evaluation of language-conditioned autonomous-driving planning models; not framed as LLM agent tool-use or coordination.
A general-purpose VLM directly reasons, acts, and adapts to feedback to operate a robot, functioning as an agent.
Attack on LLM-powered agentic recommender systems exploiting multi-agent reflection/memory propagation.
Benchmark for coding agents building complete software repositories end to end.
Framework/infrastructure for controllable multi-agent LLM coding collaboration, benchmarked against Claude Code/Codex.
Framework and audit of loss-of-control incidents and safety evaluations for autonomous agents.
Controlled comparison of RAG retrieval strategies for QA; one of six pipelines is an agentic tool-call baseline, but the main contribution is retrieval-method comparison, not agent architecture.
Decentralized architecture for scalable, fault-tolerant LLM-based multi-agent systems with self-organizing teams.
Benchmark suite for agentic AI workloads across local/hybrid/cloud execution on personal devices.
Self-evolving multi-agent LLM system (router + Mixture-of-Agents + tools) for subtitle translation; the contribution is the agent architecture.
Online self-evolving orchestration of LLM-based multi-agent tool-using systems with learned credit assignment.
Addresses a tool-use bottleneck for LLM agents performing multi-step visual retrieval.
Agent system using read-only tools over path-structured evidence to produce citation-grounded scientific answers.
Bootstraps LLM graph agents that explore knowledge graphs via tools, trained with GRPO.
RL-based post-training method for diversifying LLM agents' tool-use and interaction trajectories.
Benchmark evaluating voice interfaces for LLM-based computer-use agents.
Studies and fixes coordination failures between planner and actor LLM agents in long-horizon tasks.
Agentic, multi-turn, tool-augmented reasoning framework (22 forensic tools) for image forgery detection.
New VLM-agent learning paradigm (retrospective world modeling) with an RL-based self-consistency reward.
Model-based trajectory planning for off-road vehicles; no LLM or agent reasoning involved.
Benchmark for the security of multi-agent LLM debate under adversarial attacks.
DAG-based multi-agent LLM framework with incremental planning and RL training for deep research agents.
Connects a coding agent to robot sensing/execution with persistent experience and skill reuse; an LLM-agent-driven embodied system.
Benchmark for skill-evolution harnesses in autonomous coding agents, isolating genuine capability abstraction.
Reputation-based aggregation defense for multi-agent LLM debate under malicious agents.
Benchmark of multimodal video models' understanding of human tool use in egocentric video; not an LLM agent itself using tools.
Specializes an LLM via continued pretraining/SFT for algorithmic-trading code generation; primarily a domain code-generation application, with agentic evaluation as a secondary axis.
Tool-call authorization defense against malicious/poisoned Agent Skills; an agent-safety contribution.
Classical ILP/CBS-based Multi-Agent Path Finding post-optimization; no LLM involved.
Agentic framework (role-specific Clinical Agents) with a tool-use harness and RL post-training for medical evidence-seeking.
Systematic benchmark of LLM-based multi-agent coordination strategies for graph learning.
Benchmark of VLM-based computer-use agents operating scientific software.
VLM agent that autonomously evolves policies and orchestrates tools for video temporal grounding.
Classical belief-propagation-based Multi-Agent Path Finding under map uncertainty; no LLM.
Standardized benchmark for the speed/efficiency of computer-use agents across harnesses and models.
Self-evolving robot-agent harness coupling a reasoning module ('slow brain') with physical execution; LLM/VLA involvement is implied but not stated explicitly.
Compositional policy for adaptive agentic inference connecting NL task specs to structured exploration; explicitly about LLM-agent efficiency.
Cross-environment comparison of RL and LLM hierarchical red-team agent architectures for cyber defense.
LLM agent as high-level orchestrator choosing geometric tools; explicitly framed as 'LLM-driven agents.'
Benchmark of AI coding agents on production incident response, measuring long-horizon agentic reasoning.
Meta-multi-agent reinforcement learning for autonomous driving; no LLM involved.
Benchmark (Embodied Agent Arena) evaluating VLM agents' readiness as robot generalists.
Agent framework for auditable Lean proof development with isolated workspaces and independent review.
Empirical study analyzing issues, causes, and solutions in open-source LLM-based multi-agent systems.
Studies capability-retention vs. acquisition trade-offs in SFT on offline LLM agent trajectories.
Introduces and evaluates runtime coordination mechanisms for existing multi-agent AI-scientist systems.
Label-free, in-flow optimization method for multi-agent LLM workflows, with a new coordination benchmark.
Multi-agent LLM workflow for evidence-grounded legal research; agent-architecture contribution applied to the legal domain.
Controlled framework auditing communication behavior and effects within LLM multi-agent systems.
Hierarchical framework grounding LLM-based agent reasoning in task-and-motion planning for spacecraft.
LLM-based multi-agent architectures coordinating factory modules via MCP tool servers, compared across designs.
Directly studies how configuration choices affect agentic evaluation of coding agents, proposing systems-level evaluation.
New attack abusing an LLM agent's web-fetching tool for covert data exfiltration.
Agentic framework (Reasoner + Coder agents) for automatic heuristic design from system logs.
VLM/LLM-driven robot-agent framework reducing tokens/calls while improving task success.
Primarily a paper-retrieval benchmark for scientific inspiration; 'agentic search' is one evaluated retrieval method among others, not the paper's main agent-architecture focus.
Benchmark directly measuring LLMs' tool-use accuracy (NL-to-CLI translation) for cybersecurity tools.
Multi-agent time-series forecasting framework with no LLM; classical ML/statistical agent components applied across domains.
Agentic LLM platform (typed tool APIs, SQL-grounded agents) accelerating hardware-software co-design.
Training-free multi-agent VLM system that retrieves and reconciles evidence for wildfire reporting; agent-architecture contribution applied to a domain.
Multi-agent framework (Proposer/Actor agents) generating natural-language, tool-selected model explanations.
Offline multi-agent RL framework combining a generative foundation model with a value function; no LLM-agent focus.
Benchmark of LLMs acting as agents performing agentic programming/exploration inside a game engine.
Digital-twin-based resource-authorization defense for long-horizon autonomous coding agents (Claude, Codex).
Robustness evaluation of tool-using LLM email agents under communication-style variation.
Bayesian-network model-routing system for LLM-based CV screening; a classification/cost-routing application, not an agent with tool use or planning.
Failure-management layer that helps LLM agents recover from mid-task failures at test time.
Protein-language-model-enhanced prompting for LLM-based gene set annotation; a genomics application with no agentic tool use or planning.
Agentic framework that dynamically selects visual/audio tools during multi-turn exploration for cross-video reasoning.
Evolving benchmark of runtime security risks for workspace agents, tested across Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw harnesses.
Studies SLMs as task-tool relevance classifiers verifying agentic tool calls against task intent.
